fun {R} [Semiring R] [Repr R] [DecidableEq R] =>
  {
    reprPrec := fun p prec =>
      have termPrecAndReprs :=
        List.map
          (fun x =>
            match x with
            | 0 => (1024, Std.Format.text "C " ++ reprArg (p.coeff 0))
            | 1 =>
              if p.coeff 1 = 1 then (⊤, Std.Format.text "X")
              else (70, Std.Format.text "C " ++ reprArg (p.coeff 1) ++ Std.Format.text " * X")
            | n =>
              if p.coeff n = 1 then (80, Std.Format.text "X ^ " ++ Std.Format.text n.repr)
              else
                (70,
                  Std.Format.text "C " ++ reprArg (p.coeff n) ++ Std.Format.text " * X ^ " ++
                    Std.Format.text n.repr))
          (p.support.sort fun a b => a ≤ b);
      match termPrecAndReprs with
      | [] => Std.Format.text "0"
      | [(tprec, t)] => if ↑prec ≥ tprec then t.paren else t
      | ts =>
        (if prec ≥ 65 then Std.Format.paren else id)
          (Std.Format.joinSep (List.map Prod.snd ts)
              (Std.Format.text " +" ++ Std.Format.line)).fill }

  {T : Set α} (hT' : T = Set.iUnion S) (dir : Directed (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊆ x2) S) (op : ↑T → ↑T → ↑T)
  (opi : (i : ι) → ↑(S i) → ↑(S i) → ↑(S i))
  (hopi :
    ∀ (i : ι) (x y : ↑(S i)),
      Set.inclusion ⋯ (opi i x y) = op (Set.inclusion ⋯ x) (Set.inclusion ⋯ y))

containing the supremum of the set's image under the map to the underlying binary relation.

signature.text:
theorem RingCon.sSup_def.{u_3} {R : Type u_3} [Add R] [Mul R] (S : Set (RingCon R)) :
  sSup S = ringConGen (sSup (DFunLike.coe '' S))

doc: Definition of the infimum of two congruence relations.

signature.text:
theorem RingCon.inf_iff_and.{u_3} {R : Type u_3} [Add R] [Mul R] {c d : RingCon R} {x y : R} :
  (c ⊓ d) x y ↔ c x y ∧ d x y
